subject: Change return value of aeTimeProc callback function to long long. (#1057)
reason: The change only widens the aeTimeProc return type from int to long long, removing a 32-bit truncation of the reschedule interval in processTimeEvents (src/ae.c:366-375). Of all callbacks, only moduleTimerHandler (src/module.c:9116-9161) can return a value above INT_MAX, and only when the nearest pending module timer is >~24.8 days out. Even then the module timer's firing time is fixed at creation (src/module.c:9182) and is unaffected by the return value; truncation on the parent only makes the main event-loop timer re-fire too soon (a CPU busy-spin), while all module-timer callbacks still fire
